name: budget_check
title: Check and reserve budget
description: Reserve budget only immediately before the caller-made spend. Denial is a successful decision with allowed=false, not an execution error. Denials record attribution by default; no_record skips ingest. Never automatically replay an ambiguous check: each invocation can create a new reservation. Use `solwyn budget check` followed by `solwyn budget confirm` only around a specific un-instrumented provider spend that you make yourself. Never wrap SDK-instrumented code with `budget check` or `budget confirm`; the Solwyn SDK already reserves and confirms that spend. Fail-open is explicit: when a check returns `allowed=true` and `reservation_id=null`, skip confirm. Do not create repeated unconfirmed checks. They temporarily hold budget and can cause self-denial. Requires a write-scoped project API key; writes use its project, not the selected read project.

name: budget_confirm
title: Confirm usage and record attribution
description: Settle only a non-null reservation after the caller-made spend. Records attribution with the same call_id by default; no_record skips ingest. Recording failure does not undo settlement. Core retains a project-bound settlement receipt for 3600 seconds; retry only the identical reservation, call identity and usage within that window. The receipt is not a payload correction mechanism. After known settlement success, retry failed recording separately using record_call with the same call_id and attempt_index=0; never reserve again for a completed call. Use `solwyn budget check` followed by `solwyn budget confirm` only around a specific un-instrumented provider spend that you make yourself. Never wrap SDK-instrumented code with `budget check` or `budget confirm`; the Solwyn SDK already reserves and confirms that spend. Fail-open is explicit: when a check returns `allowed=true` and `reservation_id=null`, skip confirm. Do not create repeated unconfirmed checks. They temporarily hold budget and can cause self-denial. Requires a write-scoped project API key; writes use its project, not the selected read project.

name: record_call
title: Record completed call attribution
description: Record one caller-owned completed call without reserving or settling budget, including a record-only retry after known settlement success. Do not duplicate SDK events. Persist call_id before sending and reuse it with unchanged payload and attempt_index=0 on retries; omission generates a new ID per call. Core deduplicates the project/call_id/attempt_index identity while retained; this is not an update mechanism. Costs are server-priced. Inspect status, rejected and duplicates even when transport succeeds. Requires a write-scoped project API key; writes use its project, not the selected read project.

name: budget_check_batch
title: Check and reserve a batch
description: Reserve budget immediately before multiple caller-made un-instrumented provider calls. Checks are JSON check bodies, fully validated before submission and chunked at 32; results preserve input order. Each allowed item holds its own reservation: confirm it after its call. Unknown models return per-item errors; 404/503 fail the request. Denials record one receipt unless no_record; stopped runs must not retry under a new run ID. Admission counts each item against checks_per_minute. Denial is a valid decision, not an execution error. Do not poll or replay to refresh reservations. This client currently uses the legacy batch API: an entirely lost response has no journal lookup here. Never automatically replay an ambiguous batch; retain all known reservation IDs and original indices. Requires a write-scoped project API key; writes use its project, not the selected read project.

tags.description: Attribution tags replace SOLWYN_TAGS for this item when supplied (including null); omission uses ambient tags. At most 10 keys, keys 1–64 characters, values at most 256, no NUL; preserve whitespace/case.
